name: Website enquiries and follow-up
outcome: Connect a visitor’s request to accountable staff follow-up.
questions: What does closed mean for this business?
How are visitors contacted, and who owns the response?
rules: Name and phone or email required.
Only staff can save status and private notes in the real application.
dependencies: Shared domain primitives: text, identifier and timestamp.

nodes.name: Contact details
nodes.description: Ways to reach the person asking for help. At least one is required.

fields.name: email
fields.meaning: Optional email; validate format if present.

rules: Supply a phone number or email. Missing is not the same as an invalid email.

nodes.name: Lead / enquiry
nodes.description: A request submitted through the website, with staff-owned follow-up recorded separately from the original request.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Name of the person requesting contact.

fields.name: message
fields.meaning: Original request; optional in the existing implementation.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: new, contacted or closed; staff may update.

fields.name: seen_at
fields.meaning: First saved follow-up time in current implementation, not proof of merely viewing.

fields.name: notified_at
fields.meaning: Notification bookkeeping; not evidence of a customer reply.

rules: Public submission cannot set status, notes or bookkeeping timestamps.
Follow-up needs staff authorization. Contacted and closed are manually recorded statuses, not proof of a sent message or completed job.
Original request fields are preserved by follow-up.

stages.completion: The visitor understands what the business offers.
A valid enquiry is acknowledged and appears in the shared staff queue.
stages.handoff: The enquiry crosses to a private staff queue. This walkthrough shows both perspectives; real visitors cannot access that queue.

stages.completion: The staff member has selected the correct enquiry.
stages.handoff: The selected enquiry appears in the follow-up stage. Selection does not set seen_at.

stages.completion: A valid status and notes update is recorded.
stages.handoff: No email or phone call is made here. The customer goal still depends on staff providing a response.
